answer: Work-slot deposit burning makes mass forgery unprofitable. To claim a work slot, an agent burns a deposit of 600 credits, twice 30-day earnings. A beacon broadcasts a random audit signal; audited slots must show a heartbeat or lose the deposit. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning. A sybil operator cloning 100 identities burns 60,000 credits, and any echo of copied behavior across slots triggers a joint audit that burns the whole cluster.
